title: Design extension-field matrix GEMM via base-field decomposition (615db3b9 Phase 4)
description: Phase 4 of the finite-field LA SOTA catch-up plan (`dev/active/615db3b9-finite-field-la-sota-plan.md` § Phase 4). Designs (NOT implements) matrix-level Karatsuba decomposition for `FieldMatrix>` and `FieldMatrix>` so extension-field matmul can inherit the now-optimized base-field GEMM rather than going through generic component products. Parent epic: 026fc832. Predecessor: Phase 1 fan-in (route selection task — the base-field GEMM must be settled before designing the matrix-level decomposition). ## Background The plan's Phase 4 (verbatim): > - Quadratic extensions: compute multiplication using 3 base-field GEMMs via Karatsuba rather than 4 generic component products. > - Cubic extensions: use the existing tower arithmetic strategy but lift it to matrix-level batch GEMM. > - For `QuadraticExt>` and `CubicExt>`, route base GEMMs through existing Fp<65537> acceleration where applicable. ## Success Criteria - [hard] A design document attached via `jit doc add` that: - states the public API surface (trait additions, free functions, or method impls on `FieldMatrix`) needed to specialise matmul for `QuadraticExt<_>` and `CubicExt<_>`, - shows the Karatsuba decomposition explicitly (3 base-field GEMMs + corresponding adds/subs for quadratic; the analogous formula for cubic via Toom-Cook or recursive Karatsuba), - identifies the correctness tests required (round-trip equality vs the existing generic matmul for `QuadraticExt>` and `CubicExt>` at n in {16, 64, 256}), - identifies the benchmark cells (`QuadraticExt>`, `CubicExt>`, and at least one extension over a smaller GF(p) base) that will measure the speedup, - states the non-regression contract (no regression on existing extension-field paths used by other crates, e.g., `gf2-coding` or `gf2-algebra`). - [hard] The design cites the relevant existing files: `crates/gf2-core/src/gfpn/quadratic.rs`, `crates/gf2-core/src/gfpn/cubic.rs`, `crates/gf2-core/src/gfpn/batch.rs`, `crates/gf2-core/src/gfpn/ext_config.rs`, `crates/gf2-core/src/field/matrix.rs::gemm`. - [hard] The design lists the implementation child issues needed to land Phase 4 (separate JIT issues, with dependency order). - [hard] No production code changes in this task — it is design-only. ## Out of scope - Implementation (separate child issues filed under this task). - Cross-family scorecard (Phase 5 — separate task). - New extension-field arithmetic primitives beyond what is needed for matrix decomposition. ## Notes This task is design-only, like 615db3b9 was. It exists to surface the API design and the implementation breakdown before any extension-field matrix work is dispatched.
